bead.title: agent-loop: implement AC-FEAT-001-09 tool-call loop pivot (3-tier semantics + 3 named tests)
bead.description:
AR-2026-05-17-repo finding. FEAT-001 AC-09 specifies a configurable 3-tier tool-call-loop response: (a) hard abort when ToolCallLoopPivotLimit=0, (b) pivot+inject-pivot-message when limit>0, (c) escalate when pivot budget exhausted. Currently internal/core/loop.go:143-145,903-911 implements only (a) via a hardcoded toolCallLoopLimit=5.

Required additions:
- Request.ToolCallLoopPivotLimit int (zero preserves legacy abort-only behavior)
- EventToolCallLoopPivot event type emitted at pivot
- Result.ToolCallLoopPivots accumulator
- Three named tests: TestRun_ToolCallLoopPivot_SinglePivotSucceeds, TestRun_ToolCallLoopPivot_ExhaustedPivotsAborts, TestRun_ToolCallLoopPivot_ZeroPivotLimitPreservesLegacyAbort

Source review: fizeau-584abce2.
bead.acceptance:
1) internal/core/agent.go declares EventToolCallLoopPivot.
2) Request struct exposes ToolCallLoopPivotLimit int with zero-value preserving prior abort behavior.
3) Result struct exposes ToolCallLoopPivots []ToolCallLoopPivot (or equivalent) accumulator.
4) The three named tests in internal/core/loop_test.go pass: TestRun_ToolCallLoopPivot_SinglePivotSucceeds, TestRun_ToolCallLoopPivot_ExhaustedPivotsAborts, TestRun_ToolCallLoopPivot_ZeroPivotLimitPreservesLegacyAbort.
5) go test ./internal/core/... -count=1 green.
6) go test ./... -count=1 green.
